# CutPulse Video Splitter

> High-performance, client-side video splitter operating 100% locally in web browsers via WebAssembly. Splits videos by duration, WhatsApp status (30s), reels (90s), shorts (60s), equal parts, or custom timestamps without watermarks, without re-encoding, and without uploading files to external servers.

## Core Capabilities
- **Stream-Copy Slicing (-c copy)**: Zero quality loss demuxing. Cuts keyframe-aligned video and audio packets directly into new container segments in seconds.
- **Accurate Cut Mode**: Frame-exact microsecond precision re-encoding with customizable CRF quality profiles (high, balanced, fast).
- **Social Media Presets**:
  - WhatsApp Status (30s continuous sequential clips)
  - YouTube Shorts & TikTok (60s)
  - Instagram Reels (90s)
  - Stories & Snapchat (15s)
  - Extended TikTok (180s)
- **Equal Divisions**: Slices any video into N equal parts (2 halves, 3 parts, 5 parts, etc.) with exact mathematical distribution.
- **Custom Chapters & Timestamps**: Parses flexible time formats (e.g. `0:30, 1:15, 2:45` or `45s, 2m`).
- **Batch Export**: Downloads all clips in a single structured ZIP archive with a text manifest, or downloads sequentially to prevent browser popup blocks.
- **Audio Control**: Option to preserve original audio fidelity or strip audio entirely (Mute mode).
- **Interactive Timeline**: Real-time visual timeline map with clickable playhead scrub, segment previews, and individual segment inclusion/exclusion toggles.

## Privacy & Security Guarantees
- **Zero Server Upload**: 0 bytes of video data are transferred over the network.
- **Client-Side Sandbox**: Uses FFmpeg WebAssembly inside the browser's isolated JavaScript memory.
- **No Account Required**: Free, instant, zero signup, no cookies, zero watermarks.
- **Supported Formats**: MP4 (H.264 / H.265), WebM (VP8 / VP9), MOV (QuickTime), MKV (Matroska).
- **Recommended File Limits**: Up to 2 GB on desktop browsers, up to 500 MB on mobile devices.
